official_definition: {During Seal} Soar - (When Attacks) At the end of battle, by paying 1 cost, refresh this Spirit. (The opponent can block with exhausted Spirits/Ultimates).

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Soar] or [Soar: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Soar]", "give [Soar]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Transitions state from EXHAUSTED to REFRESHED.
